title: Filburn v People's Palace and Aquarium Co Ltd

content.caseIdentity: Filburn v People's Palace and Aquarium Co Ltd, (1890) 25 QBD 258
content.facts: Knowledge of dangerous propensity is central to the historical scienter action; negligence may be pleaded alternatively where appropriate.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
